subject: general
question: A can lay railway tracks between two given stations in 16 days and B can do the same job in 12 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 4 days only. Considering this, C alone can do the job in:
solution:
**Given:**

A can lay railway tracks between two given stations in 16 days

B can lay railway tracks between two given stations in 12 days

With the help of C, they did the job in 4 days

**Formula used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/16

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/12

Work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day = 1/4

Work done by C in 1 day = Work done by A, B, and C tog
